{{Spoilers}} {{CharInfobox |color={{yellow color}} |corecolor={{red color light}} |bordercolor={{red color dark}} |name=Sanjeev Denis |jname=サンジーヴ・デニス |tmname=Sanjeev Denis |slogan=no |image=Detective Pikachu Returns Sanjeev.jpg |size=280px |caption=Sanjeev Denis in [[Detective Pikachu Returns]] |gender=Male |colors=yes |eyes=Brown |hair=Dark brown |hometown=[[Ryme City]] |region=Unknown |relatives=Claudia Denis (wife) |game=yes |generation={{gen|IX}} |games=[[Detective Pikachu Returns]] |gameanim=no |pv=no |envagame= |javagame= }} '''Sanjeev Denis''' (Japanese: '''サンジーヴ・デニス''' ''Sanjeev Denis'') is a jeweler and owner of the [[Aurora Drop]] in the game [[Detective Pikachu Returns]]. He is considered one of the wealthiest men in [[Ryme City]]. ==In the games== ===[[Detective Pikachu Returns]]=== Sanjeev is introduced at the start of the game during Tim's first major case investigating the theft of the [[Aurora Drop]]. Sanjeev is a jeweler and owner of the Aurora Drop which had been stored securely at his [[Denis Residence|mansion]]. He hires Tim to investigate the case as Sanjeev believes that the crime had not been performed by his trusted butler [[Brandon Barnes|Barnes]] who the police and [[Brad McMaster|Brad]] believe is the culprit. During Tim's investigation, Sanjeev reveals that he had intended to donate the Aurora Drop to Ryme City as a symbol of the city's revival. This had been a cause of contention with his wife [[Claudia Denis|Claudia]]. Sanjeev is present when Tim reveals that the real culprit is one of Sanjeev's newly hired staff [[Larry Turner]]. ===Personality and characteristics=== Sanjeev appears to be a good natured man as seen by his wishes to donate the precious Aurora Drop as a symbol for Ryme City's revival.
